info.title: TurnByTurn API
info.description: Backend for TurnByTurn, a rotating savings (ajo / esusu) app. All money values are integer kobo. Errors always return `{ error: { code, message, details?, retryAfter? } }`; see docs/ERRORS.md for the code → screen map.

retryAfter.description: Seconds; also sent as Retry-After header

excessAmount.description: Confirmed beyond what was owed; pending manual review

post.summary: Create Password (3/4): activates account and signs in

get.summary: Member Home / Returning Home: cross-group overview
Universal payment list grouped by month
Filter sheet values (period, status, type, group)
My groups (empty array = No groups state)

patch.summary: Basics / Cycle (2/5): partial update; returns expectedCycleTotal

put.summary: Payout Order (4/5): full permutation of membership ids

post.summary: Activate: lock amount & order, open cycle 1
Join Group: preview (name, amount, offered position)

get.summary: Invite Members: code, link, share text

post.summary: Remind outstanding members → Reminder Sent (cooldown per member)
Pay (full or partial): returns Squadco checkout URL

amount.description: Omit to pay the full outstanding balance

post.summary: After checkout closes: confirm with Squadco (idempotent)

get.summary: Payout status (blocked / eligible / processing / sent / failed / delayed_recovery)
Public invite teaser (marketing site / deep link)

post.summary: Simulate gateway confirmation (?fail=1, or body.amount to overpay)
